title: The Impact of Debiasing on the Performance of Language Models in Downstream Tasks is Underestimated

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on downstream tasks (GLUE benchmark) by specifically extracting and evaluating subsets of instances containing female, male, and occupational (stereotypical) words. Additionally, using the Fraction Neutral (FN) metric in Natural Language Inference (NLI) tasks to measure the percentage of neutral labels predicted for gendered versus occupational premise-hypothesis pairs.
